products.manufacturerNote: Manufactured by Holophane (UK). Lumen Method is the exclusive Holophane specification agent for Australia.
products.tagline: Light shaped for comfort, people and environment.
products.summary: Pebble is a brand-new addition to the Holophane range — a post-top area luminaire built from the ground up around visual comfort, and a Build Back Better Gold Award winner. At its centre is a recessed Comfort Optic paired with Holophane's PrismaLED diffusion technology, blending the six-module LED array into a single soft, evenly lit surface instead of six individual points of glare. The optic is fully rotatable and available across five distributions, from a tight Symmetric spread to Forward Throw Extra, and the recessed design keeps ULOR at a flat 0% for genuine dark-sky compliance. Pebble ships in three mounting configurations — Post-top, Side-entry and Cradle-mount — so one luminaire family covers pathways, plazas, car parks and campus routes without changing specification. A single-fixing replaceable optical pod and a thermally engineered aluminium housing keep it serviceable in the field, and it's ready to integrate with wireless lighting controls for daylight, presence and time-based operation. Covering 3,100–20,000 delivered lumens, it's patent-pending — genuinely new technology, not a reskin of an existing range.

products.tagline: High mast area lighting luminaire with prismatic borosilicate glass refractor optics, scaling from 30,000 to 100,000 delivered lumens across 6, 9 or 12 optical pod configurations, for freight terminals, ports, airports and motorways.
products.summary: High Mast Advanced Optix (HMAO) pairs the latest high-efficiency LED technology with Holophane's glass refractor optics to deliver a complete lighting solution for new-build and retrofit high mast applications, from the simplest to the most complex area lighting layouts. Each LED module sits behind its own prismatic borosilicate glass lens, forming an individual optical pod; HMAO is built from 6, 9 or 12 pods depending on the lumen package. The glass refractor's PrismGlow effect breaks up the image of the LEDs, reducing glare and hot spots for a more uniform vertical and horizontal lighting solution, while its low electrostatic charge and the ventilated, finned heat-sink chassis create a self-cleaning optic with lower lumen depreciation over time. Seven dedicated distributions and a rotatable optical assembly allow on-site alignment to specific lighting requirements.

This reduces the glare normally associated with individual LEDs and eliminates hot spots on the working environment, creating a more uniform vertical and horizontal lighting solution. Glass's low electrostatic charge makes it less attractive to dust and dirt than aluminium or plastic optics, and works with the ventilated, finned heat-sink chassis to create a self-cleaning effect that enhances lumen maintenance over time.
